intuition.title: Why use a magneto-optical probe?
intuition.summary: The authors use magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) to probe cobalt-site electronic transitions that are difficult to resolve from bulk magnetometry alone. Their assignments are interpretations of the spectra; the paper does not report absolute cation occupancies.

intuition.title: Temperature changes the reported MCD response
intuition.summary: Figure 6 compares Method-A products prepared at 230, 250 and 270 °C; the 270 °C trace has the strongest displayed feature. The paper does not numerically integrate the traces or provide a sample-specific occupancy refinement.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
